configurationisrequired.

sections.heading: Step Instructions
sections.content:
1 Inthenavigationtree,clickUser Management >Authentication Servers.
2 IntheRADIUS Servers section,clickAdd.
3 EntertheRADIUSServerparameters:
n Priority
TheRADIUSserverpriorityisanintegerbetween-999and999(defaultis0).
WhentheretwoormoreconfiguredRADIUSservers,GaiaconnectstotheRADIUSserver
withthehighestpriority.
Lownumbershavethehigherpriority.
n Host
HostnameorIPaddress(IPv4orIPv6)ofRADIUSserver.
n UDP Port
UDPportusedonRADIUSserver.
Thedefaultportis1812asspecifiedbytheRADIUSstandard.
Therangeofvalidportnumbersisfrom1to65535.
Port1645isnon-standard,butiscommonlyusedasalternativetoport1812.
Warning -Firewallsoftwarefrequentlyblockstrafficonport1812.Makesurethatyou
defineaFirewallruletoallowtrafficonUDPport1812betweentheRADIUSserver
andGaia.
n Shared Secret
SharedsecretusedforauthenticationbetweentheRADIUSserverandtheGaiaclient.
